event_name: Date 21 October 2018 Time 14:23 2018 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 18 - 21 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 55 crossed the white line separating the pit entry and the track.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L Chapter IV Article 4 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, noticing that on entering the pit lane during the reconnaissance laps, Car 55 locked up, crossed the pit entrance line after the bollard and returned to the track instead of entering the pit lane. The Stewards judged that Car 55 returned to the track in a safe manner.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 43 2018 United States Grand Prix Decision Car 55 Crossing The White Line In The Pit Entry During Reconnaissance Laps
